## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.26

### XR0A-iR Radon Detector
- Adds the X-Sense home-card radon reading in Bq/m³, with 1-day, 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day averages, long-term day count, and peak.
- Creates battery, Wi-Fi, alarm, and end-of-life entities for the XR0A-iR station.
- Applies house mainpage state when X-Sense keys the station as `{model}-{serial}` instead of the bare serial.
- Keeps radon values in diagnostics downloads.


### Compatibility and Reliability
- Restores compatibility with Home Assistant releases back to the declared 2025.3 minimum while preserving current-Core support.
- Changes the Paho MQTT requirement to a compatible minimum version so Hassfest and Home Assistant dependency resolution can update it safely.
- Includes regression coverage for the updated dependency and the new station entity paths.
